record.office: Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Hawaii
record.t: Was sworn in on May 5, 2026, as the sixth chief justice of the Supreme Court of Hawaii.
record.q: Devens was sworn in on May 5, 2026 as the sixth Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the State of Hawaiʻi.

record.t: Was sworn in as an associate justice of the Hawaiʻi Supreme Court (2024).
record.q: Lisa M. Ginoza and Vladimir P. Devens were sworn in today as Associate Justices of the Hawaiʻi Supreme Court by Chief Justice Mark E. Recktenwald at Aliʻiōlani Hale.

record.t: Was sworn in as an associate justice of the Hawaii Supreme Court on Jan. 12, 2024.
record.q: Chief Justice Devens was sworn in as an Associate Justice of the Hawaiʻi Supreme Court on January 12, 2024.

record.t: Was nominated by Gov. Josh Green and confirmed by the Hawaii State Senate in 2023.
record.q: Green nominated Ginoza and Devens in October and they were confirmed by the Hawaiʻi State Senate in November.

record.office: Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Hawaii
record.t: As chief justice, serves as administrative head of the Hawaii State Judiciary.
record.q: As Chief Justice, Devens serves as the administrative head of the Hawaiʻi State Judiciary, overseeing court operations statewide while also leading Hawaiʻi’s highest court.

record.t: Worked in private civil-litigation practice for more than 30 years before his appointment.
record.q: Prior to his appointment, Justice Devens worked in private practice for over 30 years where he concentrated his practice in civil litigation in various areas of the law.
